### [`v0.32.2`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.32.2)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/compare/v0.32.1...v0.32.2)

Welcome to the v0.32.2 release of buildkit!

Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at
<https://github.com/moby/buildkit/issues>.

##### Contributors

- CrazyMax

##### Notable Changes

- Revert the v0.32.1 OCI artifact attestation push-order workaround, restoring BuildKit's spec-aligned behavior of allowing referrers to be pushed before their subject manifests. [#​7016](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/7016)

##### Dependency Changes

This release has no dependency changes

Previous release can be found at [v0.32.1](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.32.1)

### [`v0.32.1`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.32.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/compare/v0.32.0...v0.32.1)

Welcome to the v0.32.1 release of buildkit!

Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at
<https://github.com/moby/buildkit/issues>.

##### Contributors

- CrazyMax

##### Notable Changes

- Fix archive extraction through implied parent directories and absolute symlinks. [#​7005](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/7005)
- Fix OCI artifact attestation pushes to registries that strictly validate `subject` references. [#​7012](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/7012)

##### Dependency Changes

- **github.com/moby/go-archive**  v0.2.1 -> v0.2.0

Previous release can be found at [v0.32.0](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/v0.32.0)

Welcome to the v0.32.0 release of buildkit!

Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at
<https://github.com/moby/buildkit/issues>.

##### Contributors

- Tõnis Tiigi
- CrazyMax

- Akihiro Suda

##### Notable Changes

- Built-in Dockerfile frontend has been updated to v1.26.0. [changelog](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/releases/tag/dockerfile%2F1.26.0)
- Attestations now default to OCI artifact descriptors, use `oci-artifacts=false` if your registry does not support OCI artifacts. [#​6914](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6914)
- Build steps can now opt out of default OpenTelemetry tracing or define custom tracing configuration. [#​6958](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6958)
- Bolt database performance has been improved. [#​6943](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6943)
- Included Runc container runtime has been updated to v1.4.3. [#​6853](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6853)
- All remote cache backends now use OCI mediatypes for record descriptors. [#​6913](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6913)
- Source policy identifiers are now normalized before sending them to policy evaluation. [#​6909](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6909)
- SBOM scanner support for Windows has been added. [#​6941](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6941)
- Session exporters now support an optional finalization callback after exports complete, allowing providers to run completion logic while gateway references are still available. [#​6978](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6978)
- Lock contention in the LLB solver has been reduced. [#​6917](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6917)
- Improve SSH support when using non-standard ports. [#​6895](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6895)
- Improve validation of reading contents of invalid files via API. [#​6903](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6903)
- Deprecated OTEL fallback variables `OTEL_TRACE_PARENT`, `OTEL_TRACE_STATE` are no longer supported. Use `TRACEPARENT` and `TRACESTATE` instead. [#​6874](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6874)
- Fix possible cache miss issue on parallel builds with shared parts. [#​6955](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6955)
- Fix chunked encoding support for S3-compatible remote cache backends. [#​6970](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6970)
- Fix regression on handling `OTEL_IGNORE_ERROR` environment variable. [#​6966](https://redirect.github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/6966)
